name: Business process flow
short_description: A business process flow is the process bar shown across a Dynamics 365 record that guides users through defined stages, such as qualify, develop, propose and close for sales opportunities.

evidence.quote: Microsoft calls it a business process flow, which sounds more complex than it needs to.
You also get built-in governance like role-based security, auditing and business process flows.
Model driven apps use something called business process flows.
